name: @mos/distribution
description: MOS v2.0 social adapter contract + capability matrix (SOCIAL-001) + the five provider adapter subtrees (SOCIAL-002..006) — the social-distribution authority: provider-neutral social surface (SocialAdapterPort: publish/schedule/read-observations/delete/list-restrictions — typed inputs carrying CONTENT ARTIFACT REFS, never inline media) over versioned tenant-scoped SocialChannel records whose SocialProviderCapability matrix declares every operation supported/unsupported/unknown via the INTEG-001 provider-contract vocabulary (parity is never assumed: undeclared → typed refusal; UNKNOWN is preserved first-class with its own typed outcome). Rights AND policy gates PRECEDE every provider call: every invocation requires a RightsContextRef evaluated by the REAL injected evaluateRights (@mos/rights, denial reasons verbatim), and the declared PolicyGatePort seam (frozen contract shape; disclosed in-memory fail-closed double — the policy package arrives in a later wave). SocialObservation records are §30-observable, tenant-scoped, source-attributed WHAT-THE-PLATFORM-SAID records — never invented, never transformed into causal claims (attribution/causality is ATTRIB-001's later domain). No real network: SocialTransportPort is a declared seam with a disclosed deterministic self-labelling in-memory double; §30 records cover every attributable attempt. W7-C provider adapters (subpath exports ./providers/*): five isolated per-provider subtrees declare conservative public-knowledge provider profiles AS DATA on the SOCIAL-001 contract (per-operation capability matrix — UNKNOWN beats guessing; auth model KIND as data, NEVER credentials; coarse publicly-known operation shapes with the claim basis documented per subtree; NO fabricated provider internals — no invented endpoint URLs, rate-limit numbers or error taxonomies), enforce adapter-level fail-closed capability + operation-shape refusals BEFORE any provider interaction, and carry the idempotency/replay discipline (same logical operation retried → ONE provider operation recorded) plus transport-observed rate-limit posture records (DECLAREDLY simulated doubles, self-labeled). Provider specifics live in DATA inside the isolated subtrees, never in the shared authority-facing surface (test-pinned). W8-C adds the HEALTH-001 platform-health observation surface: OBSERVABLE-ONLY HealthObservation records where a provider-CONFIRMED restriction (from the W6-C list-restrictions surface, recorded verbatim with the exact restriction citation) is TYPED apart from a SUSPECTED distribution anomaly (a DERIVED record citing one of the two DECLARED DOCUMENTED derivation rules — observation-absence / metric-decline-window — never invented; undeclared rules and malformed inputs are typed rejections recording NOTHING); the distinction is queryable and counted separately per provider, the canonical PlatformHealthObservation projection covers the confirmed restriction only (healthState restricted, maneuvers empty), and the surface carries NO maneuver authority (observable-only §3: compliant maneuvers are the owning authorities’ decisions).
